title: Fonts
description: Makira and Paper Mono are the standard pair. IBM Plex Mono and Unbounded stay opt-in.

--- title: Fonts description: Makira and Paper Mono are the standard pair. IBM Plex Mono and Unbounded stay opt-in. sidebar: label: Overview order: 1 --- The SHAUGHV type system is two versatile families, not a headline font plus a body font. Use either one for titles, display, interfaces, body copy, or buttons. Paper Mono also gives code and data a precise grid. **[Makira](/fonts/makira)** Standard sans. Weights 400–900, static and variable. **[Paper Mono](/fonts/paper-mono)** Standard mono. Weights 100–800, static and variable. **[IBM Plex Mono](/fonts/opt-in)** Optional quieter mono with italics. **[Unbounded](/fonts/opt-in)** Optional geometric display family. ## Load the standard pair ```html HTML ``` ```css CSS @import url("https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/fonts.css"); ``` That one file imports Makira and Paper Mono, plus Gail Rock for compatibility with existing sites. The live manifest records the preferred pair in `fonts.all.defaults`. It does **not** import IBM Plex Mono or Unbounded. ## Family names | Family | Status | CSS family names | Weights | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Makira | Standard | `"Makira"`, `"Makira VF"` | 400–900 | | Paper Mono | Standard | `"Paper Mono"`, `"Paper Mono Variable"` | 100–800 | | Gail Rock | Compatibility | `"Gail Rock"`, `"Gail Rock VF"` | 100–700 | | IBM Plex Mono | Opt-in | `"IBM Plex Mono"` | 100–700, italic | | Unbounded | Opt-in | `"Unbounded"`, `"Unbounded Blond"`, `"Unbounded Variable"` | 300–900 + variable 100–900 | ## Side by side The same sentence in both standard voices:
Makira

Ready for the whole interface.

Clear at reading sizes, forceful at display sizes, and comfortable on controls.

Paper Mono

Ready for the whole interface.

Expressive at display sizes, readable in body copy, and precise for code and data.

:::warning Do not add another family to the standard bundle without an explicit brand decision. Opt-in stylesheets exist so a project can ask for a third voice on purpose. ::: ## Recommended CSS variables ```css :root { --font-makira: "Makira", system-ui, sans-serif; --font-paper: "Paper Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; --font-mono-alt: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; --font-brutal: "Unbounded", system-ui, sans-serif; } ``` The live font guide at visual font guide shows both families across display, body, interface, and control roles, plus Gail Rock's compatibility specimens.
